dish: cheap counter nigiri (three pieces for ~150 yen)
address: Janjan Yokochō (Nanyo-dori shopping street), Ebisu-higashi, Naniwa-ku, Osaka
w: OSAKA-INFO calls Daiko Sushi the famous shop of JanJan Yokochō for rock-bottom-priced sushi; Inside Osaka profiles its two Jan Jan branches ten seconds apart.

dish: okonomiyaki cooked at the table, and yakisoba with egg noodles boiled to order
address: In front of Tsuruhashi Station, Ikuno-ku, Osaka
w: The okonomiyaki chain's flagship by Tsuruhashi Station, a noren-split from the 1950 Tenma Fugetsu (ja.wikipedia); Inside Osaka lists the Tsuruhashi original.

dish: Minoh Beer craft ales (World Beer Awards winners) with brewery-only food
w: Osaka's best-known craft brewery, a World Beer Awards winner (ja.wikipedia 箕面ブリュワリー); OSAKA-INFO features the brewery's directly-run WAREHOUSE taproom for its exclusive food pairings.

dish: kurumi mochi (mochi in a secret green bean paste) and kōri kurumi mochi shaved ice
w: Sakai sweet shop founded in the late Kamakura period (~690 years) whose fifth-generation owner invented kurumi mochi — featured by OSAKA-INFO and Time Out's Sakai guide.

dish: watarigani (Japanese blue crab) course — sashimi, salt-grilled, sake-steamed, crab rice
w: Claims to be Japan's only watarigani-specialist restaurant; reservation-only, three groups a day — in Time Out's 20 must-go restaurants of Southern Osaka and Serai (Shogakukan).
